hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook for ETH/phiETH pools that implements 1:1 swaps by intercepting beforeSwap: it takes the input token from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit or phiEth.withdraw to convert, then settles the output directly — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Direct liquidity additions to the pool are blocked via beforeAddLiquidity revert.
